reader.requirement: At --std 85, when control reaches a PERFORM's specified set (paragraph, section, THRU range, an independent segment) by fall-through or GO TO while no PERFORM of that set is executing, control passes through the end of the set to the next executable statement; a return point is armed only for an executing PERFORM.

edition-consulted.switches: SegmentEntry (1985 Segmentation, independent segments) adds a last-used flag and __EnterSegment around the dispatch; DebugActive (1985 USE FOR DEBUGGING) adds debug-cause scaffolding; the bounded __Dispatch(start, exit) return test is unchanged

reader.edition-search: grep of ControlFlowEmitter, DispatchEmitter, EmitterState for Edition/Year/DialectBehavior: the return mechanism (a range's exit pc is a return point only for the __Dispatch call that a PERFORM made) consults no edition; the only 1985 arms are the segmentation and debugging scaffolding that exist only for 1985 source
reader.behaviour-differs-by-edition: no for the fall-through itself; at 85 a program with independent segments or USE FOR DEBUGGING carries extra scaffolding around the same return test

reader.notes: An out-of-line PERFORM is a recursive bounded __Dispatch(start, exit) call; the at-exit return fires only inside that call, so control reaching the same paragraph by GO TO or fall-through in the caller's dispatch loop runs on to pc+1. Behaviour is structural and the same at every edition; the 1985 segmentation arm was probed (p9c).

refuter.evidence: Read §1985:VI.6.21.4 GR9 with GR11 and GR14 (an inner PERFORM that passes control to an outer active PERFORM's exit or shares its exit is not a conforming program, so those are not attack cases). Probes: q9a (class c, the 1985-only USE FOR DEBUGGING arm the reader listed but did not probe): P-B under USE FOR DEBUGGING performed, then reached by a THRU range, by GO TO and by fall-through; printed 'DBG P-B PERFORM LOOP / B / M2 / A / DBG P-B FALL THROUGH / B / M3 / A / DBG P-B FALL THROUGH / B / C / DBG P-B / B / C / END': each non-PERFORM entry passes the end of P-B to P-C. q9b (class e): a declarative section first PERFORMed, then entered by the I-O error of OPEN INPUT on a missing sequential file and of a READ on the unopened file: 'D 00 / M2 / D 35 / M3 35 / D 47 / M4 47', control returns after each failing statement and never falls into the next declarative or the main section. cite.py: 'OK  §1985:VI.6.21.4 GR9 ... the text is in GR9'.
